text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha haha haha!!
No way, that's impossible~! Ain't you exaggerating?

Nishino Flower looks like she wants to talk to
Toosen Jordan. However, Toosen Jordan is
totally absorbed in conversation with her friend.

text_block_list.name: Gal Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally not! And so the pun battle between
Nakayama and the President went on for like 10 minutes.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Fr fr!? I so wanted to see that!
Got any video? A clip, anything!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hm? ...Ah, my bad, gonna step out for a sec.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey, was Flower-chan just here?
choice_data_list: Yeah. Looked like she was waiting for you.
Yeah. Looked like she was waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Aww man, my bad...

Just then, I notice a small plushie
keychain lying by our feet.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: That belongs to Flower-chan.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Guess I'll leave it with Bourbon.
They're roommates, so that's way more reliable.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
'Sup, Bourbon.
I picked up something Flower-chan dropped.
Could you hand it back to her?

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Acknowledged. I will hold onto it.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wait, you read these kinds of magazines too, Bourbon?

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The one reading this magazine was Flower-san.
She has been brooding every night while reading it...
In order to investigate the cause, I purchased a copy myself.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Flower-chan did?

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hmph... Wonder what part she was reading.

Curious, I check the contents of the magazine too.
The article Nishino Flower might be reading is...

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
DIY... Keyword search complete.
Result found: Making a resin table.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: A table? She's making one?

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Analyzing Flower-san's recent actions,
I deduce it is for a table set beside the flowerbed.
The root of her concern is likely table crafting.
choice_data_list: Maybe she came to ask you for advice on that earlier.
Maybe she came to ask you for advice on that earlier.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Me, doing DIY? Do I look like the DIY type to you!?

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, the only DIY article matching the
keywords Flower-san muttered while reading
is the resin table.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Lacquer", "Polish", "UV Light".
It likely refers to coating wood with lacquer paint, covering
it in resin, curing it with a UV light, and polishing it.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Ain't that about nails?

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
..."Nails". Cross-referencing database
for the presence of matching terms.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! That's all nail stuff!
The table idea makes zero sense!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I see~. Maybe she wanted advice on coords earlier~.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However... this article does not contain
the keywords Flower-san was muttering
while reading the magazine.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Under broad interpretation, shoe maintenance applies,
but it is hardly a complete match.
Is coordinate styling truly her dilemma?

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What was Flower-chan saying anyway?

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I detected the words
"Lacquer", "Polish", and "UV Light".

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Ain't that about nails?

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
..."Nails". Cross-referencing database
for the presence of matching terms.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! That's all nail stuff!
Like, where did shoes even come from!?

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
So "Lacquer", "Polish", and "UV Light"
are used in nail care as well.
I must update the database.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
If it's nails, maybe it's from the Sweets Contest.
Got curious and wanted some advice?

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, leave that aside for a sec.
Bourbon, hold out your hand.
I'll do your nails for ya.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Why is there a necessity to apply nails to me?

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
'Cause Flower-chan seems interested.
Might make a good conversation starter, right?

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Plus, it'd be way easier for Flower-chan
to bring it up with her roommate Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
I gladly accept the order.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Don't have much time, so just your index finger.
But trust me, I'll make it suuuper cute!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
All right, done!
Well then, Bourbon, good luck!
